answer_1.quote: We introduce the novel task of entity insertion. Entity insertion. We consider Wikipedia as the primary use case and focus on the task of adding links. Specifically, given a source and target entity, the goal of entity insertion is to identify the most suitable text span in the article describing the source entity for inserting a link to the target entity.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs a ranked list of text spans in the source article as candidates for inserting a link to the target entity.

answer_2.quote: We use (1) Hits@1, and (2) mean reciprocal rank (MRR) to evaluate the quality of the benchmarked methods.

answer_3.quote: PRP-Allpair (Zero-shot only): to assess the relevance of candidate text spans to the target entity in a pairwise manner using GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, and then uncover the ranking from all pairwise comparisons.
